t: You're on Lower Sloane Street, in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Two people with connections here are worth knowing. Victor Gordon-Lennox was born on this street in 1897. He was an army officer and then a journalist, a diplomatic correspondent for the Daily Mail and the Daily Telegraph. Before the Second World War he was an editor of an influential conservative newsletter called The Whitehall Letter. John Ellis Talbot, a Conservative politician who also worked as a solicitor and building society manager, both lived and died on this street. He died in 1967.
